Julie / Everest team —

Thanks again for the sync yesterday. I wanted to pull together a concise snag log ahead of our MAP triage to make the 5/10 call productive. High-level blockers we surfaced: 

1) MSA redlines: Everest legal pushed back on the standard data residency and retention clauses (Sections 4.2/7.1). They want explicit language preserving EU-data-in-region options and a shorter log retention window. See attached: EVT-2093_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf (redline + comments).

2) Order form: finance flagged a mismatch between the negotiated committed throughput and the PO line items — Procurement needs a single-line PO-ready amount and a PO name to complete vendor setup.

3) Vendor setup: Everest SSO/contact for vendor onboarding needs to be created in your vendor portal — we provided an onboarding template (everest_vendor_setup_template.xlsx) but it looks like procurement needs a vendor code to move to payables.

4) SOC2 evidence request: your audit team asked for an updated SOC2 cover letter and an architecture summary. We can provide both but need the exact list of items your compliance team requires.

Proposed next steps (for 5/10 triage):
- 15m slot to agree on MSA redline owner (legal-to-legal).
- Procurement to confirm PO line item and supply vendor code by EOD 5/11.
- Redwood to deliver SOC2 cover letter + architecture summary by 5/12 if we get the list by 5/10.

Can you confirm who on your side will own MSA redline negotiation and the vendor portal contact? I can loop in our legal lead (Laura) and procurement (Karthik) to expedite.

Attachments: EVT-2093_MSA_redlines_v1.pdf, everest_vendor_setup_template.xlsx

Thanks,
Sean

Thanks, Sean — quick note from procurement/legal side.

We received the redline and a few initial comments from our counsel. The main sticking points are: 
- Data retention: Everest policy requires deletion of logs containing PII within 90 days unless covered by a specific retention schedule.
- Subprocessing: need a clause requiring notification + 30-day right to object for new subprocessors.

I'll attach our internal comment doc (Everest_MSA_comments.docx). Our legal lead on this is Maria Chong (maria.chong@everesttech.com) — she will be the primary redline owner. For vendor portal/setup, please direct questions to procurement@everesttech.com; they'll need the PO-ready amount and W-9 (or equivalent).

We can do the 5/10 triage at 10:00am PT. Can Laura and Karthik attend?

Julie
